definition.simple: A powerful muscle pump in your chest that works non-stop to push blood around your body.
definition.academic: A muscular organ in most animals that pumps blood through the blood vessels of the circulatory system.

examples: You can feel your heart beating faster when you run or exercise.

common_misconceptions: Students often think the heart is shaped like the romantic heart symbol (❤️). It is actually shaped more like a fist.
ai_context.tutor_hint: Ask the student why the heart beats faster when they run.
